issue.title: Upload takes recorded while already online [Returning online and sync changes Audit]
issue.body:
Found during the returning online and synchronizing changes audit (#530, epic #526).

**Severity:** Medium  
**Launch blocker:** No  
**Confirmed on:** Xiaomi Redmi Note 9 Pro, Android 10 (API 29), local debug build of `09ff2fd` (PR #559 head), `dev.api.fluent.bible` (scenario E.19)

## Summary

Takes recorded while the device is already online never upload on their own.

Upload sessions start only on a connectivity or cellular-toggle change, app start, or Sync Now (`src/services/uploadOrchestratorCore.ts:271-314`, `:352-357`). Saving a take, the end of the 24 h pause window and a failed session (`:210-217`) never start one.

## Expected

Unsynced takes upload automatically while the server is reachable and transport allows it (#150).

## Actual

Online on Wi-Fi, a new take stayed pending for 5 minutes; the Sync page showed Sync Now enabled.

## Steps to reproduce

1. Online on Wi-Fi, record a take.
2. Wait on Home for a few minutes; check the header and the Sync page.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Saving a take while online and eligible starts (or queues) an upload without user action.
- [ ] When the pause window ends, auto-upload resumes without a connectivity change.
- [ ] After a failed session, a later automatic retry is scheduled (per #150's retry default).
- [ ] Unit tests for each trigger.
- [ ] Android device QA (E.19).

## Related

- Parent audit: #530 (epic #526)
- #150, #151
- Assessment: `docs/assessments/returning-online-and-sync/README.md` (PR #598)
